embed.title: !location
embed.description: Set the point that `d:` distances are measured from, and save named locations to use on individual rules.

fields.name: Your location
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}location 51.5074,-0.1278` — set it by coordinates
`{{prefix}}location 10 Downing Street, London` — set it by address (if the server has a geocoder)
`{{prefix}}location` — show it
`{{prefix}}location remove default` — clear it

Each profile has its own location; this sets the one for the profile you are on.

fields.name: Saved locations
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}location add home 51.5074,-0.1278` — save a named location
`{{prefix}}location add work Canterbury` — or save one by address
`{{prefix}}location add "holiday home" Santa Monica` — put quotes round names with spaces
`{{prefix}}location list` — your location and all saved ones
`{{prefix}}location show home` — show one (`default` shows your location)
`{{prefix}}location remove home` — delete one (refused while a tracking rule uses it)

Names are stored in lower case. Saved locations are shared by all your profiles. To move one, remove it and add it again.

fields.name: Use on tracking rules
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}track pikachu d:500 location:home` — measure from "home" instead of your location
`{{prefix}}track pikachu area:north,south` — use these areas instead of your selected ones

`location:` needs a `d:`. `area:` can't be combined with `d:` or `location:`. Your admin may limit the `d:` distance.

fields.name: Related
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help area` — choose your areas
`{{prefix}}tracked` — shows which rules use `location:` or `area:`
